title: gpt-oss-20b via Ollama
slug_note: OpenAI's open MoE in one command; Ollama's tag is 14 GB.

variation.quant_detail: Ollama's `gpt-oss:20b` tag, 14GB; MXFP4 experts as OpenAI shipped them
variation.revision_note: Ollama model ID shown by `ollama list` on the Spark when measured (2026-10-24)

requirements.notes: Measured on a DGX Spark: 19.6 GB resident at Ollama's default 128K context (weights + KV). Smaller boxes get a smaller default context and less KV. Earlier estimate: OpenAI: the 20B runs within 16 GB of memory. KV headroom not measured.

steps.text: Install Ollama (see Step 0 in Quick start).

measurements.method: spark_bench.py via the Ollama API, Ollama 0.40.10, single stream, fresh nonce per run so every prefill is cold, one warm-up run discarded, 256 output tokens, median of 3; 679-token prompt
spark_bench.py via the Ollama API, Ollama 0.40.10, single stream, fresh nonce per run so every prefill is cold, one warm-up run discarded, 256 output tokens, median of 3; 4705-token prompt

drop in MemAvailable from cold (OS file cache dropped) to loaded after `ollama run gpt-oss:20b`, at the default context Ollama chose (131072 tokens)

caveats: Ollama 0.40.10 on a 128 GB DGX Spark picked a 128K default context by itself, so memory use is well above the file size. Set num_ctx lower to save memory, or keep it for long documents.
No speed or memory numbers recorded yet; the size is Ollama's listed tag size.
Reasoning effort (low/medium/high) is set in the system prompt and changes speed and accuracy a lot; record it with any number.
Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-10-24): `ollama run gpt-oss:20b` answered after 8.3 s from a cold start (model files read from disk).
